title: Concept: Conan remote with TLS verification off
description: conanfile.py declares a `verify_ssl` switch set to false, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a `verify_ssl` switch set to false.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through conanfile.py (conan).
risk: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a `verify_ssl` switch set to false.
